body:
```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1952+g187d13aa60
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1792527110
```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/187d13aa6047e1914244e8033b2d2f3379a0b97f) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v1.4.241
body:
## Chats and a browser that behave the way you expect 🧭

This release makes chats follow your agent settings, brings Chrome-style tools to the built-in browser, and helps SSH connections and managed servers recover. You’ll also find a chat font setting, live agent browsing, and steadier Hermes, Kimi, Kiro and Windows terminals.

## The short version

- **Chats that follow your settings:** New chats use each agent’s permission from Settings → Agents, renamed chats keep their names in Session History, and a chat won’t write a conversation a terminal is still running.
- **A browser closer to Chrome:** Dock DevTools inside the pane, mute tabs playing sound, see a link’s URL on hover, and use Orca shortcuts and mouse back/forward inside pages.
- **Watch agents browse:** A cursor and badge show where an agent is clicking or typing, chat jumps you to the page, and links from terminals and chat open beside their source.
- **SSH with fewer dead ends:** Saved port forwards return after a restart and explain failures, certificate-only hosts connect through your system `ssh`, and managed servers update without closing terminals.
- **Agents that start and resume reliably:** Hermes and Kimi panes resume after a restart, Kiro reports status on its V3 engine, and keys typed while an agent starts are kept as a draft.
- **Polish where it counts:** Pick a font for chat, zoom with Cmd/Ctrl + `+` on non-US keyboards, open cloud-only files from macOS terminals, and get steadier Windows terminals and pasting.

**Phone & web updates:** Phones no longer drop pieces of terminal output, and chat renames and each chat’s permission mode now show there. Session tabs also keep Working and Needs You for Windows agents that never set a title.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Fresh terminal host:** New terminals start on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply. Terminals already open before you update keep running, and stay attached, on the previous host until you close them.
- **Chat permissions:** Settings → Chat no longer has its own permission dropdown; set it per agent in Settings → Agents. Existing chats keep their saved permission, and a chat’s own permission menu changes only that chat.
- **Conversations open in a terminal:** If a terminal might still be writing a conversation, its chat won’t send and asks you to quit the agent there or close that terminal. Closing that terminal lets the next send go through.
- **Managed SSH servers:** **Update anyway** keeps running terminals going through the update. The offer to resume chats after a restart needs a server already running this release.
- **OpenCode model picks:** OpenCode 2.0.14, 2.0.15, 2.0.17 and 2.0.18 leave the first message unsent when a model is picked, so Orca refuses model picks on those versions.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Chats share your agent settings, keep their names, and stay out of conversations a terminal is still writing.*

* Start new chats with each agent’s permission setting from Settings → Agents, the same as terminals by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32334
* Never start a chat’s agent on a conversation a terminal is still writing, and keep restored panes from resuming a conversation an open chat holds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30930
* Save chat renames as the chat’s name, so Session History, phones and other windows keep showing them after the tab closes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31602
* Show turns made outside an OpenCode or Grok chat when the chat continues by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31616
* Offer to resume interrupted chats after a paired or managed server restarts or updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28978
* Add a custom font family setting for chat, with a preview and installed-font suggestions by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33687
* Retry a failed agent start before rejecting your message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33045
* Keep goal text whose delivery is uncertain, and send each distinct goal control to the host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33022
* Keep an idle Claude chat idle when a background task reports progress by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22879
* Fold Claude thinking-only transcript records into the reasoning section by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33344
* Honour Claude Code’s rejected ANTHROPIC_API_KEY setting in chats by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33346
* Keep long Pi replies with lots of thinking from stopping early by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33293
* Reconnect an OMP chat when OMP drops its session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33359
* Keep a remembered effort for OMP models other than the running one in new chats by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33646
* Stop refusing new Pi chats when a remembered effort is missing from the saved model list by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33637
* Read WSL Claude transcripts through linked folders, so chats from Orca-managed Claude accounts load on mobile by @Kooooojun in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33172
* Keep a resting Codex chat’s skills check from blocking worktree removal on Windows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33569

### Browser

*Chrome-style DevTools, tab audio and link previews, plus a live view of agents using the browser.*

* Dock DevTools inside the browser pane, with dock side, resizing and pop-out by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33003
* Show a speaker icon on browser tabs playing sound, with tab mute by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32981
* Show a hovered or focused link’s URL in a bubble at the bottom of the page by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32978
* Make Orca shortcuts, split focus and mouse back/forward buttons work inside web pages by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31859
* Open browser links beside their source by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32907
* Show agent browsing live, with a jump to the page from chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33075
* Ask before sites use the local network by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33399
* Show bigger new tab tiles and a roomier workspace card by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33178

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Agents start on the first try, report the right status, resume in the right place, and keep the right account.*

* Keep the permission pill inside Arguments and share the Permissions menu by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32971
* Skip Codex’s startup update prompt when Orca launches Codex by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33355
* Keep keys typed into a starting agent pane as an unsubmitted draft by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33315
* Press Enter again while a Windows Codex composer is still reading a long task by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33295
* Press Enter again while DeepSeek Harness’s launchpad still holds the prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33316
* Make flagged `--command` agent launches wait for the agent’s screen to be ready by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33466
* Deliver Devin launch prompts on its command line instead of typing them after start by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33349
* Start a Claude worker on its composer when its terminal title is turned off by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33384
* Pre-trust the folder for Kimi Code so its trust menu does not swallow the prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33411
* Refuse model picks on OpenCode 2.x releases that drop the startup prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33436
* Recognize Qwen Code launched through Node on Windows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33461
* Keep Codex from reading as idle while its plan menu is showing after its Stop hook by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33335
* Let a settled screen clear a blocked-prompt state left over after the agent erased its dialog by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33485
* Show Needs You while a Claude MCP elicitation dialog is open by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33517
* Let a pane’s own agent reclaim its status from a nested agent’s hooks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33572
* Keep agent status on a terminal moved into a new tab after a restart by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33601
* Stop an Antigravity subagent finishing from ending its parent’s turn by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33645
* Keep Pi in-process subagent sessions from taking over the lead pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33595
* Follow Claude sessions continued into a daemon job by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33605
* Keep launch flags on a woken agent’s record so a restart restores them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33523
* Resume an agent from the folder it ran in, not the pane’s starting folder by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33527
* Resume Hermes panes after a restart, on the pane’s own session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33514
* Keep a finished Hermes pane done when its background memory review calls tools by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33418
* Use the Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes home for Hermes hooks and session history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33413
* Recognize Hermes readiness and its installed launcher by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33606
* Keep a resumed Kimi pane resumable across the next Orca restart by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33489
* Report Kiro status on Kiro’s V3 engine, including the built-in default agent by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33660
* Run the native Windows Claude hook for profile paths with spaces by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33364
* Exit skipped Windows hook replays without waiting on input by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33470
* Let the WSL hook relay run on the Orca server’s bundled Node by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33089
* Show DeepSeek Harness rows for WSL terminals on Windows by @denchu-unagi in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31205
* Start Claude Agent Teams teammates on headless Linux servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33389
* Capture Git Bash agent environments with native Windows paths by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33619
* Write folder trust into the managed Codex account home the launch uses by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33377
* Apply global ~/.codex/rules in Orca-managed Codex homes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33493
* Migrate resumed Windows Codex sessions whose transcript path has a \\?\ prefix by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33558
* Index a new WSL Codex account home before bringing history into it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33630
* Read the sign-in link Codex prints on stderr when adding a Codex account by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29811
* Keep the old Codex login until re-authentication finishes, and relabel swapped account homes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33568
* Keep the selected Antigravity account after agy refreshes its token by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33656
* Resume Claude in the folder it was started in after an account-switch restart by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33659
* Leave your node or python program alone after a Claude account switch by @adifsgaid in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30328
* Share folders Claude created in an account folder before its first setup by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33479
* Show an idle Claude account whose access token lapsed as waiting for Claude, not signed out by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33542
* Show a Claude Enterprise seat’s monthly spend cap when it has no 5-hour or weekly window by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33655
* Count fork-copied Codex token events once in usage by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33478
* Show Codex usage while Codex’s session index is stuck rebuilding by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33636
* Keep Codex automation and agent-created threads in Agent Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33477
* List Claude sessions stored under a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set only in your login shell by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33506

### Orchestration

*Mail reaches workers when they can take it, and worker starts fail clearly instead of stalling.*

* Let a new `orca orchestration check --wait` start while an old one is still waiting by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33013
* Wake an agent for new mail even while it still holds an unacknowledged batch by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33639
* Point idle headless terminals at their mail by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33258
* Submit mail pointers to Cursor CLI instead of leaving them in the composer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33347
* Hold mail pointers while the agent shows an open dialog by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33366
* Hold mail pointers while the composer has an unsent draft by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33429
* Press Enter again when DeepSeek Harness’s launchpad refuses a worker’s first task by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33499
* Start Antigravity workers in a terminal when its chat runtime isn’t installed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33520
* Fail a Codex worker’s dispatch when its session can’t reconnect by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33543
* Let worker-start reuse an idle native-install Claude terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33544
* Paste CLI prompts as one block for every recognized agent, not just Claude and Codex by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33571

### Terminals

*A fresh terminal host, steadier Windows terminals, and history and folders that survive sleep, restarts and phones.*

* Start new terminals on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33705
* Respawn a Windows ConPTY pane that started without keyboard input by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33423
* Keep a Windows terminal’s output-relay write error from stopping the terminal host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33391
* Send Ctrl+Enter to Claude Code on Windows in the form it understands by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33473
* Preserve OpenCode Ctrl+Enter on Windows by @Pr1p in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33149
* Keep Windows Codex multiline Ctrl+V and Edit > Paste as one draft by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33339
* Keep restored history when ConPTY repaints after a resize by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33577
* Apply the terminal host’s ConPTY resize rule in the window too by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33584
* Send ESC d for Option+Forward-Delete on macOS by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33296
* Let macOS terminal shells download cloud-only files by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33623
* Show the stalled terminal host banner when the host is actually stalled by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33000
* Bound folder permission checks while creating terminal sessions by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33643
* Clean up an agent’s leftover tools when closing a plain shell pane on macOS and Linux by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33317
* Let agents run exit hooks before an immediate close force-quits them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33367
* Don’t resume an agent whose terminal is still running by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33380
* Keep fish’s startup terminal reply out of the Codex composer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33381
* Wait for escape sequences to finish before resetting the cursor of an idle agent by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33616
* Keep split color sequences intact during a quiet terminal restore by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33677
* Stop false recovery warnings in running full-screen programs when pane sizing is slow by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33474
* Confirm a live agent has exited before resetting its mouse modes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33603
* Start a woken pane’s new prompt on its own line when reattached by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33494
* Let Kiro’s terminal relay release the shell-ready wait by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33495
* Finish saving history before a shutdown’s connection can close by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33504
* Keep desktop history when a hidden pane is revealed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33534
* Keep desktop terminal history after a phone opens the terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33537
* Wake a slept WSL pane on Windows in the folder its shell was in by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33398
* Keep history and folder for a slept pane the relaunched app had not reopened yet by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33425
* Keep the folder of a WSL pane a relaunched window reattached when it is slept by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33496
* Reopen a slept agent whose tab is gone in a fresh tab instead of stranding it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33598

### SSH & remote servers

*Port forwards that come back, more hosts that connect, and managed servers you can update without closing terminals.*

* Bring saved SSH port forwards back after a restart that reconnects through the host’s Orca server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33388
* Show saved SSH port forwards that couldn’t start, with the reason, and let you remove them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33450
* Retry over system ssh when the built-in client shares no algorithm with the host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33680
* Add Update and Update anyway for a managed SSH server, keeping its running terminals by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33397
* Move an SSH host onto its managed server even when a pane saved no terminal history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33681
* Explain that adding a project on a paired server’s SSH host isn’t supported yet by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33284
* Drop a paired server’s old workspace rows when it relists them under new project ids by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33396
* Keep one paired runtime’s updates from dropping another runtime’s terminals in a shared workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33414
* Fix `orca agent hooks` commands on headless Orca servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33700
* Drive Android emulators from headless `orca serve` hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33701

### Workspaces, sidebar & everyday polish

*Workspaces stay on the right branch and dialogs don’t get stuck, with quicker previews and tidier sidebar controls.*

* Keep each same-path workspace copy on its own host’s branch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33428
* Start the agent when a workspace is opened during creation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33562
* Keep the create-worktree dialog from getting stuck on a stalled setup step by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33400
* Explain the shallow-clone warning for keeping local main up to date, and let you stop the refresh by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33260
* Keep the Jira Board view selected in Tasks after you leave the page by @kazuki-hanai in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30588
* Keep the workspace hover card open behind link actions by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33409
* Close the link chooser when you click elsewhere on a hover card by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33679
* Show tab previews after 500 ms instead of 800 ms by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33447
* Keep the sidebar header buttons in place when switching to Activity by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33648
* Give the notification bell room for its status and count by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33683
* Make Cmd/Ctrl + zoom in on non-US keyboards by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33014
* Keep Orca CLI commands working in sandboxes that deny chmod by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33662

### Phone & web

*Phones keep every piece of terminal output and the right agent status, and explain what they can’t show.*

* Stop phones losing pieces of terminal output by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33405
* Keep Working and Needs You in a phone’s session tabs on Windows agents that never set a title by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33614
* Explain why a file outside the workspace can’t be shown on the phone by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33341

### Tests, builds & maintenance

*Broader behavioral coverage with fewer low-value tests, faster local checks and dev setup, continued module organization, a repository-wide comment cleanup, and relay service improvements.*

<details>
<summary>All test, build and maintenance changes</summary>

* Log the relay director’s zone and round-trip speed on each runtime line by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33372
* Cap how many reserve relay cells a director outage sends to the database by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33415
* Build the macOS terminal host on a patched Node runtime to recover stalled workers (reverted later in this release, apart from its stall telemetry) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29133
* Return the macOS terminal host to official Node, keeping stall telemetry by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33688
* Clean up after the agent integration fixes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33644
* Repair main’s line limits and a stale test import by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33675

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.59
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- Opening Orca after your computer updates is about twice as fast. Downloads are decoded faster, and only the files that changed are fetched instead of the whole app.
- The download progress bar now fills smoothly instead of jumping to the end.
- Going back to a screen you already have open takes you there instead of opening another copy.
- Terminal output that the phone sometimes dropped, such as the screen reset after a full-screen program exits, now shows up.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

### Verify your download

- Size: `136281689` bytes
- SHA-256: `f8a18086b04dc00966431edc4d484132d6fc8dc08a5d88009a3246317a12f343`

A "no certificate" or "problem parsing the package" install failure is usually a truncated download — check the size first, then `sha256sum -c app-release.apk.sha256` (`shasum -a 256 -c` on macOS).

Cloud workers no longer pay extra CPU for overlapped capture. Studio preview copies also show progress, can retry, and remember their quality.

## Features

# HyperFrames v0.8.201

Released on 2026-10-26.

Studio no longer gets stuck on a leftover history lock, so chat and edits keep working after a restart. Renders on a Mac decode video faster, and hidden clips stay hidden in preview and render.

## Features

- **Studio:** Zoom the timeline to the selected clips ([d787681d12e89](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d787681d12e89f8adc8123e66ab9dfa37e8dc86f), [#5824](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5824)).

- **CLI:** Stop shipping an env var name that endpoint scanners flag ([cbf1176cf02b5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cbf1176cf02b59d80df8863726b1eb5af10ff0ec), [#6369](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6369)).

- **CLI:** Preserve distinct Lottie animations during capture ([3aca8060b8cd9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3aca8060b8cd9c7e13183fef1a1616e7d4939fe4), [#5293](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5293)).
- **Core:** A root without data-duration stays on screen after its GSAP timeline ends ([0ae48c9f33d20](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0ae48c9f33d20ab5a92f999e6e25f6bbc3d108ab), [#6354](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6354)).
- **Core:** A self-closed audio group no longer hides the clips after it ([33685ef2beb17](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/33685ef2beb17495f66ca21a101649b38ccc96d6), [#6344](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6344)).
- **Producer:** Never probe a hidden video clip ([059a6e55d409f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/059a6e55d409f934eec95ee12744226737b1a502), [#6340](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6340)).

## Performance

- **Studio Server:** Copy alpha cut-outs several pieces at a time ([e4bdf8c51cf7c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e4bdf8c51cf7cc2f8386567dfda0d2639d93e11f), [#6342](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6342)).
- **Studio:** A settled timeline's composition check scans only its hosts, not the whole preview ([e48c8a0614f25](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e48c8a0614f252413d191f49816a4809c44e860b), [#5880](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5880)).
- **Engine:** On a Mac, video frames for a render decode on the media engine ([e51ec11caa457](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e51ec11caa457a11dcad4c1f11135e4df781c229), [#5878](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5878)).
- **Producer:** Chunks capture frames round-robin so the encoder runs during capture ([924da50637a0d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/924da50637a0d0125627708d19dfd494b8b6b12e), [#6364](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6364)).
- **Core:** Keep long-media analysis responsive and sample the whole clip ([84b63193463ba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84b63193463bac2e3e7f8500d03fb7da9fbf8846), [#5793](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5793)).
- **Core:** Look up the root only for composition elements when sizing a clip window ([b054bb98febe2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b054bb98febe2f0fa79519c3c0f1a7f946d273af), [#6361](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6361)).
- **Core:** A film opens and seeks without pre-styling every hidden scene, cuts stay smooth ([6bc0b68be09de](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6bc0b68be09de915d72571bc30f8c1b4709b3c7c), [#6356](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6356)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Guides:** Media pages titled by the task people search for ([a4e6bc3254af6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a4e6bc3254af622ad1b286979add556682893dd8), [#6360](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6360)).
- **Guides:** One page per kind of video, with its prompts folded in ([5353171155473](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5353171155473d1e75941306800d8909690c8cb1), [#6359](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6359)).
- **Producer:** Clarify ProRes capture precision ([6c053bc8e7b3e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c053bc8e7b3ebc0fcb23b7545ee6250679b51c2), [#6244](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6244)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Explain long-video planning limits ([fc625ac97138c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fc625ac97138cd7a3ca9dc0a5448f42575d3b5a8), [#5263](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5263)).
- **Guides:** Pages for making videos with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor ([5bb9431a987f5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5bb9431a987f5b72b2f0a0a2e88763dfd20db904), [#6352](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6352)).

## Internal

- **Studio Server:** Raise the package size budget to the measured size plus headroom ([c80e449920c5c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c80e449920c5c276c060c2b36e20e1d5a4a672ef), [#6370](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6370)).
- **CLI:** Wait for the lookup child to die after the CLI exits ([e63ecd5d84a6d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e63ecd5d84a6d1dd879cd697f9a2ba4662063fcb), [#6357](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6357)).
- Guard the edit-accuracy gate against a failed changes job ([c8876431e964a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8876431e964aeeee4d762cd2ad651642d481a10), [#5182](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5182)).
- Re-run changed test files to catch flaky tests before merge ([35a28e913a51d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/35a28e913a51db55ecd4dc83d553e3defe5f9e9c), [#6339](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6339)).

## Full changelog

name: v0.8.200
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.200

Released on 2026-10-25.

The preview draws only the scenes near the playhead, so long projects scrub faster. Renders size their capture browsers by frame cost and keep fast capture on for more frames.

## Fixes

- **Producer:** The audio peak correction sizes its cut from the PCM it re-encodes ([1a37db4aee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1a37db4aee9349e6c619313475159e90b49da083), [#6312](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6312)).

## Performance

- **Core:** The preview mounts and draws only the scenes near the playhead ([70187a13b5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70187a13b59118cf056f3bcdcd0c0df8f453a9f8), [#6189](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6189)).
- **Engine:** Fast capture stays on for frames a shadow, blur or clip effect does not touch ([c50918277a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c50918277ae69b45677c200e95575faec5fd1519), [#6318](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6318)).
- **Producer:** Size a chunk's capture browsers by its frame cost, not its frame count ([69405a7736](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/69405a7736830f743dc2a8192c36f26dac99d4ae), [#6319](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6319)).

## Internal

- Run cli tests in their own job so runtime tests stop timing out ([8214cdcd29](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8214cdcd295de9542a05b8484ccf1b48ed97937b), [#6326](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6326)).

## Full changelog

name: v0.8.199
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.199

Released on 2026-10-25.

Long HDR videos now render without filling the disk, and parallel capture stays on after one failed frame check. Lint warns when a scene's styles sit outside its template.

## Features

- **Lint:** Warn when a scene's styles sit outside its template ([ad6771c435](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ad6771c435e6fb57c540f630820d2a1265c0c63d), [#6317](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6317)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** --workers N is a ceiling, drawElement renders keep their single worker ([26e3045e3b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/26e3045e3b2805ae10b3090c3254a04de4f372e3), [#6314](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6314)).
- **CLI:** A failed frame check no longer switches parallel capture off for good ([d3a7599c60](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d3a7599c60f1fe7f0993ce25c890a232048633e2), [#6313](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6313)).
- **Producer:** Extract HDR video frames a window at a time to bound scratch disk ([7569ec1be5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7569ec1be58082980a7493c893bca5b7fdc8ca31), [#6304](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6304)).
- **Studio:** Scrubbing never auditions a track the music row did not name ([9763b68a33](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9763b68a33aca8c4cf29a6d3bda7cb887ba86332), [#6310](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6310)).
- **Core:** The decoded-audio cache keys a clip the same way everywhere ([80ba3f59ec](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80ba3f59ec601e16f43525310ebf5a2ea450704e), [#6306](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6306)).
- **CLI:** A long video copy reports progress, resumes in 15 s pieces and stops only when stalled ([ada9932d4e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ada9932d4e2f12831f96c08b0acc3fedc3c7cc24), [#6307](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6307)).

## Performance

- **Core:** Mounting a scene no longer restyles it to look for raster hints ([89af290808](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/89af2908080cb7da8013d7133d8bf3cbe86d12e4), [#6300](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6300)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Skills:** Say a volume lane multiplies data-volume ([9b80c2d01e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9b80c2d01efa48ae48cd702129def7ec4eb6faf4), [#6308](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6308)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** Check the browser that ran the hanging script, and that every browser it started is gone ([d4812a0393](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4812a03937ecab8e572cb909004d84d35260066), [#6320](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6320)).
- **Engine:** Count what the mixer read from a cloud file, not what the server buffered ([7b76377534](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7b76377534a78b3d8d4cfe1614da3cf16280cca7), [#6315](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6315)).

name: v0.5.7 — VoiceStudio
body:
**First, an apology.** This release took much longer than it should have. Urgent family matters kept me away for a while, and I'm sorry for the wait and for the issues that sat unanswered meanwhile. Thank you for your patience and for every report, fix and kind word in the meantime.

**Welcome Shimul Debnath ([velixio](https://github.com/velixio)) to the core team.** Shimul now helps maintain VoiceStudio — reviewing pull requests, triaging issues and keeping releases moving — so the project no longer waits on one person.

**VoiceStudio now runs on your phone and on PCs without a GPU, and the whole app is calmer.** Preview iOS and Android apps run models on the phone itself, GPU-less computers get the small CPU PyTorch build, and the sidebar, Models, Dubbing, Stories and Workflows pages were redesigned around fewer, clearer controls.

This release also adds an opt-in Beta update channel, a bottom player for takes, a GPU acceleration panel with honest Radeon reporting and the Ask VoiceStudio Agent, plus hundreds of fixes to cloning, dubbing, audiobooks, downloads and dictation.

**Download**

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-win-x64.exe) |
| Windows ARM64 (experimental) | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-win-arm64.exe) |
| macOS Apple Silicon | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| macOS Intel | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-mac-x64.dmg) |
| Linux x64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-linux-x64.AppImage) · [deb](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-linux-x64.deb) · [Snap Store](https://snapcraft.io/voicestudio) (`sudo snap install voicestudio`) |
| Android | [APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.apk) · [AAB](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.aab) |
| iPhone | [Sideload IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-ios-unsigned.ipa) — sign with your own Apple ID |

**Upgrading:** Install over your existing Electron app; voices, projects and settings are kept. If setup asks, choose **Install local runtime** to refresh its dependencies.

- Remote compute devices, remote workers and GPU sharing moved to VoiceStudio Pro and are no longer in the open-source app; saved projects, voices and settings are unaffected (#2748)
- Models without a plainly commercial licence, including the default OmniVoice model, ask you to accept their licence once in Model Catalogue; until then, API and MCP requests that use them return a licence error (#2689)
- Docker, LAN or reverse-proxy access by a host name, without an API key or session, needs that name in `OMNIVOICE_ALLOWED_HOSTS`; IP addresses, `localhost`, `*.ts.net` and `host.docker.internal` work as before.
- URL imports from servers on your own network need `OMNIVOICE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URL_IMPORTS=1`.
- [Where to set these variables](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/api-auth.md#requests-from-other-websites-and-host-names): a line in `~/.config/omnivoice/env` (macOS, Linux) or `%USERPROFILE%\.config\omnivoice\env` (Windows) for the desktop app, `-e` for Docker.

**Moving from Tauri:** Close the app, back up its data directory, install Electron, and verify your voices and projects before removing Tauri. Follow the [migration guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/electron-migration.md). Tauri v0.5.3 remains the final Tauri release; its updater cannot install Electron.

**Installer trust:** macOS installers are signed. Windows installers are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn; the **Installer signing** table above shows each platform's result. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/install/troubleshooting.md).

### Phone apps

Preview builds that run models on the phone, offline once they are downloaded.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| [VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.apk](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.apk) | Android: install directly (allow installs from this source) |
| [VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.aab](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.aab) | Android App Bundle for Google Play |
| [VoiceStudio-0.5.7-ios-unsigned.ipa](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-ios-unsigned.ipa) | iPhone: unsigned device build; sideload with your own Apple ID (for example, Sideloadly) |

The iPhone IPA was built from the same v0.5.7 source tag. It is not a TestFlight/App Store build; App Store signing is currently blocked by Apple’s certificate limit. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

### Installer signing

| Platform | Signing |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| macOS (Intel) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| Windows x64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Windows ARM64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Linux x64 | — Linux packages are not code-signed |
| Android | ✅ Signed with the VoiceStudio release key |
| iPhone | Unsigned sideload IPA: sign with your own Apple ID; App Store signing remains blocked by Apple’s certificate limit |

**Highlights**

- Preview iOS and Android apps that run VoiceStudio on your phone, offline once the models are downloaded
- A calmer app: redesigned sidebar, one Models list per family, cleaner Dubbing, Stories and Workflows pages, and a bottom player for takes
- PCs without a dedicated GPU install the small CPU PyTorch build and run; Windows on ARM gets an experimental native installer (#2500, #2611)
- Voice cloning finds the speech-to-text model you installed from Model Catalogue and explains clips that are too long (#2442, #2498) — thanks [drakeo338](https://github.com/drakeo338), [Bad-ptr](https://github.com/Bad-ptr)!
- Opt-in Beta update channel in Settings → Updates: get fixes early and roll onto the next stable release automatically

### Changed

- Desktop downloads are now named `VoiceStudio-<version>-<platform>-<arch>` (no "Electron"); the install scripts still find older releases' files (#3504)
- Every collapsible section uses the same chevron, labels like Target languages and Cast are no longer shouted in capitals (with several bad translations fixed), and Home's contributor avatars no longer leave a gap above the cards (#3497)
- Calmer screens: header links sit beside search instead of looking like page titles, Transcribe and Stories stop repeating the same hint, "1 chapter" reads correctly, and the Directorial AI tool is described in plain words (#3493)
- Dubbing is calmer: one-row source with a File actions menu, a preview of the loaded file, files without sound shown as a note instead of an error, and a tidier Dub into panel (#3465)
- Workflows is easier to use: templates open from a picker, steps are added from a toolbar on the canvas, the name is edited in the header, and steps missing settings are flagged before you run (#3464)
- Calmer title bar and sidebar: quieter Get Pro and Star buttons on one line, the page title shown once, a labelled speed/quality control with an Auto tooltip, and evenly sized navigation rows (#3454)
- The Colab notebook now downloads the speech-to-text model during setup, so voices you clone in the web UI get a transcript right away (#3440) — thanks [Liularina](https://github.com/Liularina)!
- Model downloads read the same everywhere: queued, progress with speed and time left, verifying, cancelled or failed with Retry and the exact next step, and running downloads appear in the notifications bell (#3437)
- The language picker lists supported languages first, keeps the rest behind one Show all languages row, shows recent choices on top and groups regional variants under their language (#3431)
- The Voice refinement hint now says fewer passes can lower quality (#3412, #3429)
- Home contributor credits show everyone's current GitHub profile picture, refreshed weekly and still bundled for offline use (#3407)
- Mobile Home keeps titles and contributor portraits compact, with maintainer cards and refreshed GitHub photos (#3406)
- The sidebar device status reads Local (#3399)
- Settings → Models shows one list per family: install, licence and select each engine and its models on the same row, with multi-model engines expanding inline (#3398)
- The demo voice is called Demo Voice, and the library tabs read Saved and Recents (#3397)
- The second sidebar has one clean, flat background with outlined sections (#3396)
- The sidebar's device and speed/quality block is calmer and aligned, with a ticked slider (#3390)
- The collapsed sidebar shows the VoiceStudio logo, which turns into the expand icon on hover (#3381)
- Stories has a calmer script editor: lines size to their text, chapter titles show as headings, each line gets one row of speaker, voice and tone chips, and the setup pane uses tidy collapsible sections (#3374)
- Core team cards on Home show full names in a friendlier card that follows the app theme (#3372)
- Velixio's core team card links their website (#3362)
- Velixio's core team card links their X profile (#3356)
- Latest take shows one quiet details line with the script beside its title, and the library tabs have icons (#3354)
- Home now shows the core maintainers large on top with profile cards, and other contributors smaller below (#3353)
- Report a bug asks for a one-line description and lists what will be sent before opening the prefilled GitHub issue (#3338)
- First-run setup shows the install folder with free space, long labels wrap instead of clipping Next, and macOS window buttons line up with the title bar (#3336)
- Credential fields have visible labels and token checks show Verified/Failed badges; the command palette now finds settings pages and items (#3335)
- The engine status screen is a single pill with elapsed time, repeated failures are counted, the raw log sits under Details, and a busy engine shows a slim reconnecting bar (#3334)
- A failed engine start now names one cause (blocked launch, native crash, missing environment, permissions, synced folder) and leads with the matching action: Choose another folder, Copy diagnostics or Retry (#3332)
- Failed generations now name the likely cause (GPU memory, missing model, busy engine, timeout) with fix chips and the raw error under Details, and never show a proxy HTML page (#3331)
- Android and iOS add native production workspaces, book import and MP3/M4B export, detailed dub editing and audio tools, resumable processing, widgets, paired calls and a local speech API, and generate real cloned-voice previews before saving (#3325)
- Android matches the iOS workspace layout with a compact Home, grouped controls and accessible icon navigation (#3312)
- Changelog entries are now one small file per pull request in `changelog.d/`, folded into the release notes at release time, so pull requests no longer conflict on `CHANGELOG.md` (#3282)
- The sidebar is a slim icon rail beside each section's own pane: Home and Clone get a Saved voices / Recent takes column, Design gets a Saved voices tab, and the full navigation is one click away (#3234)
- The GitHub button in the top bar is one Star pill with the live count, and the star fills gold on hover (#3234)
- Stories, Audiobook and Dubbing show their saved projects in a Projects tab beside the controls, so your files are one tap away wherever you work (#3234)
- Source ZIPs and tarballs omit scam-moderation attack examples; Git clones and CI retain their regression tests (#3237)
- Maintainers can upload public source ZIPs or individual files with `make virustotal`, or scan a branch through the manual VirusTotal Actions workflow (#3237)
- Small models now install with as little as 2 GB spare disk; the setup check only warns below 10 GB instead of blocking (#2969)
- iOS Home shows Electron's contributor avatars, Dub is redesigned around one source card with animated icons, and the iOS bottom dock is icon-only (#2969)
- Model licence review on iOS and Android opens with a plain summary, rights rows and licence links; the raw terms move under Exact terms (#2969)
- Phone apps now use the app ID `sh.voicestudio.mobile`; a preview build installed before installs alongside as a new app, so pair it again and remove the old one (#3194)
- The sponsor footer is gone from the app; sponsored integrations keep a Featured badge on their card in Integrations (#3031)
- The expanded sidebar shows the installed app version beneath VoiceStudio and clearly marks development builds (#2894)
- The Pro page lists only what Pro adds; recipes, watch folders and voice cloning stay free (#2587)
- App identity and backend, browser and Electron development ports now come from one validated configuration file (#2759)
- Keep synthesis controls anchored at the bottom when the latest take appears (#2759)
- Using a Gallery design voice opens its workspace immediately and defers model loading until audio is requested (#2759)
- Models without a plainly commercial licence, including the default OmniVoice model, must have their licence accepted once before use; VoiceStudio is not the licensor and cannot grant model rights (#2689)
- The model licence dialog gives a plain summary, what the licence allows and collapsible details; acceptance records the date and exact terms, and changed terms ask again (#2689, #2755)
- Pro, export and enterprise text, in all 21 languages, makes clear that the app licence doesn't grant rights to models or generated audio (#2587)
- Desktop installers include the app's licence notices (#2587)
- Home cards use feature-specific SVG icons with brief hover and keyboard-focus animations that respect reduced motion (#2407)
- Renamed the Dub workspace to Dubbing across navigation, project labels, and keyboard shortcuts (#2407)
- Home prioritizes creation tools with clearer descriptions and controls; the footer can collapse and reopen (#2407)
- Enter Studio opens its optional permissions and shortcut settings expanded by default (#2407)
- Model packs can be selected and installed before preset-compatible engines are active, with changes applied only when installing or using the chosen pack (#2407)
- First-run setup stops Intel Macs before downloading dependencies and explains remote-backend access (#2419) — thanks [JoAdo07](https://github.com/JoAdo07)!
- Machines without an NVIDIA GPU install the small CPU PyTorch build (about 5 GB instead of 9 GB free) and load voice models in float32 instead of float16 (#2500) — thanks [RobAsticles](https://github.com/RobAsticles), [tiropictor](https://github.com/tiropictor)!
- Engines that could use a GPU report a CPU fallback, naming the card, when the installed PyTorch cannot use it (#2468, #2501) — thanks [Pates2004](https://github.com/Pates2004)!
- Setup names your Radeon card instead of blaming a missing NVIDIA driver, and ignores a ROCm override on Windows and macOS (#2468, #2501) — thanks [Pates2004](https://github.com/Pates2004)!
- Source setup selects CPU wheels before installing dependencies and preserves them on restart; development launches resolve Electron's binary before starting Vite (#2436) — thanks [RobAsticles](https://github.com/RobAsticles)!
- Audio quality and Voice controls open as compact popovers from the Synthesize box on Clone and Voice Design (#2419)
- The Synthesize button shows its keyboard shortcut as key chips inside the button (#2419)
- The language menu stays within the window instead of clipping at the edges (#2419)
- Choose a voice adds photo cards, Newest/A–Z sorting, search, and click or drop photo uploads (#2419)
- Sidebar adds Fast, Balanced, Quality and Max choices, a separate Auto toggle, quieter engine status, and compact Simple, Models and Details views (#2419)
- Sidebar adds hardware-aware Auto with live resource usage and TTS-first model selection, and groups compact engine status with icon-based Simple, Models and Details views (#2396)
- LLM setup verifies a model response before enabling features, replaces the misleading engine inventory with connection guidance, and supports authenticated local servers (#2397)
- LLM skills can use installed coding CLIs through the repair-agent runner, native paid providers through LiteLLM (#2397)
- Dubbing supports Google Cloud Translation and Amazon Translate with explicit provider setup (#2397)
- OmniVoice sidecars reuse installed speech recognition for short references without transcripts, matching in-process cloning (#2320) — thanks [ewh1tman](https://github.com/ewh1tman)!

- A busy attached backend shows as unresponsive instead of crashed, and background status polls no longer starve the backend worker pool (#2608) — thanks [be-huge](https://github.com/be-huge), [aanbiluitel-sys](https://github.com/aanbiluitel-sys)!

- The CLA check accepts the sign line without a final full stop and replies when a comment cannot be recorded (#2586)
- CLA rechecks clear older approvals, reject duplicate PR heads, and block failed status updates (#2556)
- Keep audiobook chapter boundaries when importing CR-only manuscripts (#2508) — thanks [rudycelekli](https://github.com/rudycelekli)!

- Count interrupted sidecar installs and report unreadable engine scans in Storage usage (#2479) — thanks [rudycelekli](https://github.com/rudycelekli)!

- Concurrent job events receive unique sequence numbers (#2419) — thanks [sedatdagg](https://github.com/sedatdagg)!

- GitHub Star count refreshes from the repository API, and macOS tray icons keep the intended menu-bar size (#2419)

- Preserve float audio and requested seeds through OmniVoice/VoxCPM2 sidecars, and keep playback and saved WAV precision consistent (#2406)

### CI

- The release helper opens a release pull request and tags `main` after it merges, instead of pushing to `main` (#3492)
- Release builds no longer fail on the Intel Mac runner over a test that assumed the host can install the local runtime (#3490)
- Avoid false stuck-loading reports when background polling overlaps UI crawler checks. (#3383)
- Pull requests from forks wait for a maintainer's approval before CI uses any runner, so outside PRs can no longer queue the whole matrix unreviewed (#3341)
- CI: the macOS release signing check retries Apple's staple validation, so a dropped connection no longer fails a tag run (#3330)
- CI finishes about four minutes sooner: the UI crawler's route shards are balanced by cost and the platform smokes no longer wait for the Electron tests (#3310)
- Pull requests can merge through a merge queue that tests each one once on the latest `main`; the workflows are ready, a maintainer turns the queue on in the ruleset (#3309)
- Pull requests that only change locale files or package.json no longer start the iOS and Android builds; `main` still builds on them (#3308)
- Settings no longer crashes in the smoke and UI-crawler builds: the test Vite config now defines the build commit, and a guard test keeps every renderer config in step with `env.d.ts` (#3304)
- The Electron renderer smokes run as their own CI job and the UI crawler is split into three shards, so the slowest CI job drops from ~21 to ~9 minutes (#3303)
- A test now pins that a backend missing health checks during a model download is shown as unresponsive and recovers on its own instead of being declared failed (#3185) — thanks [nirmalchatur](https://github.com/nirmalchatur)!
- The mobile workflow captures Google Play phone screenshots of the Android app on an emulator and keeps them as a download (#3277)
- Pull requests that only change Python, docs, mobile or non-Electron workflows skip the Electron-only CI jobs (UI crawler, Desktop UI, native package), cutting their CI time from ~26 to ~8 minutes; deleted or renamed files, unknown paths and a failed lookup always run everything (#3271)
- CI cancels a pull request's older run when it is pushed again, older Docker builds on main are cancelled, and review-bot comments no longer take a runner, so mass pushes stop flooding the queue (#3260)
- Release notes open with the installer signing table, so you see which downloads are signed before the changelog (#3255)
- macOS release builds retry once when Apple's ticket server drops the notarization staple, instead of failing the whole release (#3244)
- Release notes list everyone who contributed since the last stable release automatically, instead of only the people thanked by hand (#3242)
- Release notes list each platform's installer signing as measured on the build, and a macOS build that would open as "damaged" can no longer be released, and macOS releases are signed with the Developer ID again (#3241, #3243)
- The owner can let named maintainers publish releases while Windows installers are still unsigned (#3236)
- Android release and Play builds share an increasing version code to prevent reused or decreasing build numbers (#2969)
- Phone build resources keep notice hashes and localized text intact on Windows (#2969)
- New `mobile-release` workflow builds signed Android and iOS apps and drafts a GitHub prerelease with the APK, AAB and IPAs (#2969)
- The `mobile` workflow builds the pinned on-device runtimes for both apps (#2969)
- The main test step runs in parallel with pytest-xdist, about 3 minutes faster per CI run (#3223)
- Interactive release helper: pick stable or beta, draft or publish, and confirm by typing the tag (`scripts/release.py`) (#3187)
- Release helper choices are arrow-key menus (#3190)
- Desktop UI tests no longer fail at random when Electron's debugger takes the dev proxy's port; the proxy now binds an OS-assigned port (#3126)
- Desktop request-guard self-tests stay deterministic when app requests arrive during cleanup (#2676)
- New `mobile` workflow builds and tests both phone apps; a contract test fails when their theme or API description drifts from the desktop app (#2965)
- iOS TestFlight workflow: maintainers can upload a signed iPhone build for internal testers from `main` ([guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/mobile.md#testflight-maintainers)) (#3188)
- iOS TestFlight builds declare their exempt encryption, so uploads no longer wait on the export compliance question (#3230)
- iOS TestFlight uploads with on-device inference pass App Store validation, and the workflow checks every bundled framework before uploading (#3235)
- Beta and stable release builds no longer fail when a slow build machine runs the app's tests (#3232)
- Android Play internal testing workflow: the matching signed Android upload from `main`, and beta versions no longer break the Android build ([guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/mobile.md#play-internal-testing-maintainers)) (#3189)
- Gallery preview fallback smoke no longer flakes when a slower runner reads the playing clip in several byte ranges (#3018)
- The Windows ARM64 installer is built for ARM64 only, and the packaging rehearsal runs on Windows, Intel Mac and ARM64 without host-specific test failures (#2615)
- Pull requests fail when a commit uses a leaked personal email, a placeholder identity, or an AI agent identity, or when a commit or the description credits an AI agent (#2556)
- GitHub Actions are pinned to exact commits and kept current by Dependabot (#2556)
- Release Docker images publish when the GitHub Release is published; `:latest` only ever comes from `main` (#2578)
- One bun, TypeScript and Playwright version and one lockfile across the workspace; frontend unit tests run in the required check (#2578)
- Tests keep the review-bot configs, issue-template labels and locale catalogs consistent (#2578)
- Trusted base-branch checks reject leaked, placeholder, and AI agent identities while allowing human co-authors with names shared by agents (#2556)

name: v0.5.7-beta.3 — VoiceStudio
body:
### Installer signing

| Platform | Signing |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| macOS (Intel) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| Windows x64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Windows ARM64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Linux x64 | — Linux packages are not code-signed |
| Android | ✅ Signed with the VoiceStudio release key |
| iPhone | Not in this beta; the iPhone build ships with 0.5.7 |

**Highlights**

- Preview iOS and Android apps that run VoiceStudio on your phone, offline after downloading the models
- Opt-in Beta update channel: get fixes early from Settings → Updates, and roll onto the next stable release automatically

### Changed

- Workflows is easier to use: templates open from a picker, steps are added from a toolbar on the canvas, the name is edited in the header, and steps missing settings are flagged before you run (#3464)
- Calmer title bar and sidebar: quieter Get Pro and Star buttons on one line, the page title shown once, a labelled speed/quality control with an Auto tooltip, and evenly sized navigation rows (#3454)
- The Colab notebook now downloads the speech-to-text model during setup, so voices you clone in the web UI get a transcript right away (#3440) — thanks [Liularina](https://github.com/Liularina)!
- Model downloads read the same everywhere: queued, progress with speed and time left, verifying, cancelled or failed with Retry and the exact next step, and running downloads appear in the notifications bell (#3437)
- The language picker lists supported languages first, keeps the rest behind one Show all languages row, shows recent choices on top and groups regional variants under their language (#3431)
- The Voice refinement hint now says fewer passes can lower quality (#3412, #3429)
- Home contributor credits show everyone's current GitHub profile picture, refreshed weekly and still bundled for offline use (#3407)
- Mobile Home keeps titles and contributor portraits compact, with maintainer cards and refreshed GitHub photos (#3406)
- The sidebar device status reads Local (#3399)
- Settings → Models shows one list per family: install, licence and select each engine and its models on the same row, with multi-model engines expanding inline (#3398)
- The demo voice is called Demo Voice, and the library tabs read Saved and Recents (#3397)
- The second sidebar has one clean, flat background with outlined sections (#3396)
- The sidebar's device and speed/quality block is calmer and aligned, with a ticked slider (#3390)
- The collapsed sidebar shows the VoiceStudio logo, which turns into the expand icon on hover (#3381)
- Stories has a calmer script editor: lines size to their text, chapter titles show as headings, each line gets one row of speaker, voice and tone chips, and the setup pane uses tidy collapsible sections (#3374)
- Core team cards on Home show full names in a friendlier card that follows the app theme (#3372)
- Velixio's core team card links their website (#3362)
- Velixio's core team card links their X profile (#3356)
- Latest take shows one quiet details line with the script beside its title, and the library tabs have icons (#3354)
- Home now shows the core maintainers large on top with profile cards, and other contributors smaller below (#3353)
- Report a bug asks for a one-line description and lists what will be sent before opening the prefilled GitHub issue (#3338)
- First-run setup shows the install folder with free space, long labels wrap instead of clipping Next, and macOS window buttons line up with the title bar (#3336)
- Credential fields have visible labels and token checks show Verified/Failed badges; the command palette now finds settings pages and items (#3335)
- The engine status screen is a single pill with elapsed time, repeated failures are counted, the raw log sits under Details, and a busy engine shows a slim reconnecting bar (#3334)
- A failed engine start now names one cause (blocked launch, native crash, missing environment, permissions, synced folder) and leads with the matching action: Choose another folder, Copy diagnostics or Retry (#3332)
- Failed generations now name the likely cause (GPU memory, missing model, busy engine, timeout) with fix chips and the raw error under Details, and never show a proxy HTML page (#3331)
- Android and iOS add native production workspaces, book import and MP3/M4B export, detailed dub editing and audio tools, resumable processing, widgets, paired calls and a local speech API, and generate real cloned-voice previews before saving (#3325)
- Android matches the iOS workspace layout with a compact Home, grouped controls and accessible icon navigation (#3312)
- Changelog entries are now one small file per pull request in `changelog.d/`, folded into the release notes at release time, so pull requests no longer conflict on `CHANGELOG.md` (#3282)
- The sidebar is a slim icon rail beside each section's own pane: Home and Clone get a Saved voices / Recent takes column, Design gets a Saved voices tab, and the full navigation is one click away (#3234)
- The GitHub button in the top bar is one Star pill with the live count, and the star fills gold on hover (#3234)
- Stories, Audiobook and Dubbing show their saved projects in a Projects tab beside the controls, so your files are one tap away wherever you work (#3234)
- Source ZIPs and tarballs omit scam-moderation attack examples; Git clones and CI retain their regression tests (#3237)
- Maintainers can upload public source ZIPs or individual files with `make virustotal`, or scan a branch through the manual VirusTotal Actions workflow (#3237)

- Small models now install with as little as 2 GB spare disk; the setup check only warns below 10 GB instead of blocking (#2969)
- iOS Home shows Electron's contributor avatars, Dub is redesigned around one source card with animated icons, and the iOS bottom dock is icon-only (#2969)
- Model licence review on iOS and Android opens with a plain summary, rights rows and licence links; the raw terms move under Exact terms (#2969)
- Phone apps now use the app ID `sh.voicestudio.mobile`; a preview build installed before installs alongside as a new app, so pair it again and remove the old one (#3194)

### Added

- Optional native CosyVoice 3 GGUF engine with Vulkan or CPU routing; Python CosyVoice and the default engine are unchanged ([setup](docs/engines/cosyvoice-gguf.md)) (#3449) — thanks [dutch2005](https://github.com/dutch2005)!
- Find and replace in the Dubbing transcript: jump between spoken and original matches, replace the current spoken hit or every spoken occurrence, and undo the edit as one step (#3446) — thanks [mvanhorn](https://github.com/mvanhorn)!
- Voice Cloning now offers IndexTTS2 text and eight-slider emotion controls, also supported by /generate (#3445) — thanks [XiaoPuOuO](https://github.com/XiaoPuOuO)!
- Optional local whisper.cpp transcription and translation with GPU support from your own whisper-cli build (#3442) — thanks [dutch2005](https://github.com/dutch2005)!
- The Community gallery filters by pack and language, marks new voices, and links contributors' GitHub profiles (#3438)
- Uyghur can be a dub and batch-dub translation target, and scripts and transcripts in right-to-left languages (Uyghur, Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu) now read right to left (#3404, #2810)
- Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal) are separate language choices for speech and dub translation (#3143, #2752); plain Portuguese keeps meaning Brazilian, and number words follow the chosen variant (#3403)
- Docker: a native arm64 NVIDIA CUDA image for DGX Spark and Grace servers, under -cuda-arm64 tags such as :stable-cuda-arm64 (#3402, #2831) — thanks [Jason69628723](https://github.com/Jason69628723)!
- Docker: an opt-in OMNIVOICE_TRUST_HOST_LOOPBACK=1 lets the host's own browser skip the share PIN, while other machines still need it (#3401, #3003)
- Dub exports gain a Background volume slider (0–400%) so quiet music and ambience can be raised or lowered in the mix (#3379) — thanks [NeverBeLazyG](https://github.com/NeverBeLazyG)!
- Add project transfer, advanced dubbing, branching workflows, gallery voice imports and transcription history to iOS and Android. (#3357)
- Recent takes and project audio play in an app-wide bottom player with a seekable waveform (#3355)
- Home marks debpalash and velixio as core maintainers across clients, and Android UI checks support fixed workspace controls (#3314)
- Opt-in Windows ROCm setup installs and verifies a matched, hash-pinned AMD stack for source and Electron, with HIP faster-whisper support and explicit optional-engine limits, incorporating work from #2600 and #2607 (#3045) — thanks [dutch2005](https://github.com/dutch2005) and [Pates2004](https://github.com/Pates2004)!
- OmniVoice GGUF can run on Vulkan GPUs on Windows and Linux, with CPU fallback, a native device choice, reuse of already-installed weights and checksum-verified runtime libraries (#3042) — thanks [dutch2005](https://github.com/dutch2005)!
- Bug reports and Settings → Diagnostics now show the build commit next to the version, so beta and preview builds of one version can be told apart (#3293)
- The backend and Docker images report their build commit in `/system/info` and in bug reports (#3293)
- The phone apps have a Report action on every generated result: pick a reason, add an optional note, and it reaches the VoiceStudio team only when you tap Send (#3268, #3276, #3281)
- The phone apps run speech, dictation, voice cloning and dubbing on the phone itself, offline once you download the models; pairing a computer is optional ([guide](docs/mobile.md)) (#2969)
- Beta update channel: choose Stable or Beta under Settings → Updates; betas are `-beta.N` prereleases that never reach Stable users, and Docker gets matching `:beta` tags ([guide](docs/update-channels.md)) (#3175)

- Preview iOS and Android companion apps: drive your own VoiceStudio from your phone (speak, voices and cloning, dubbing, dictation) after pairing by QR code; build from source for now ([guide](docs/mobile.md)) (#2965)
- Smart Fit speed limits: set the fastest and slowest speed dubbing may apply to a line, from the Timing section (#3026) — thanks [MoonDragon-MD](https://github.com/MoonDragon-MD)!

### Fixed

- Loud streamed preview chunks are scaled to fit instead of clipped, and long renders no longer report a fast chunk as taking 0.0 s (#3466)
- Reference passages trim leading and trailing silence before selection, so clones no longer start or end mid-pause (#3461) — thanks [alvig060121-afk](https://github.com/alvig060121-afk)!
- Automatically selected reference passages are trimmed to the nearest pauses, so clones no longer start or end mid-word (#3461) — thanks [alvig060121-afk](https://github.com/alvig060121-afk)!
- Voice cloning on 8 GB unified-memory Macs frees the reference speech model before synthesis, so cloning no longer swaps until it times out (#3461) — thanks [alvig060121-afk](https://github.com/alvig060121-afk)!
- The Community gallery picks up the new World Voices pack again: a stale submodule had rolled its content back, and CI now blocks that (#3459)

- Voice Design is calmer and clearer: the take pane no longer has an icon over its Style, shows which language new takes use and follows each new take, Reset to description only appears when there is something to reset, and dialect and accent names are translated (#3456)
- The generation bar no longer slides Synthesize over the language and quality pills in narrow windows, and when text-to-speech isn't ready its main button becomes Set up instead of a dead Synthesize (#3453)
- The bottom player names each clip by where it came from (voice design, cloning, conversion, audiobook or story), shows the take's length right away, and shortens long titles on a word boundary (#3452)
- whisper.cpp reports a missing model path instead of loading another model, speaker refresh no longer assumes English, and reused takes keep only the emotion they used (#3451)
- A model download cancelled from the notifications bell no longer counts as finished, retry cooldowns count down, and recovered dictation keeps Portuguese and German words (#3448)
- Setup no longer refuses to retry for lack of disk space when the space is held by a cancelled download, and a long audiobook chapter on an older backend is no longer flagged as stalled (#3443)
- First-run setup names the host each download comes from, says when a download has stalled instead of looking frozen, and no longer piles up unfinished downloads on the disk when you cancel and retry (#3436)
- Audiobook and Stories renders now show progress within each chapter, time left, the realtime speed and a clear stalled warning, and no longer reload the engine for every chapter (#3435)
- Voice Design follows a new seed on audio.cpp, CosyVoice and MLX-Audio, and says KittenTTS, Sherpa-ONNX and PocketTTS cannot design instead of repeating one preset voice (#3413, #3434)
- Docker builds parse security override files correctly with newer packaging versions (#3433)
- Dictation removes "uh"/"um" and stutters, fixes all-caps and stray spaces before punctuation, joins Chinese and Japanese without spaces, and can type spoken punctuation such as "comma" and "new line" (#3432)
- LAN sharing lists your Wi-Fi/Ethernet address first instead of Docker, VM or VPN addresses, and shows a self-check with the listening port and a firewall hint (#3415, #3430)
- Even out volume now levels quiet and loud passages without flattening peaks or lifting room tails, and effect-preset limiters no longer compress below their ceiling (#3412, #3429)
- Dubbing splits a short reply off the previous speaker's line in the CLI and phone companion too, and a speaker who only talks in short turns gets a clone instead of the default voice (refs #3419) (#3428)
- Agent code repair accepts any folder of your git clone and says why a picked folder can't be used, with the clone command and a docs link (#3416, #3427)
- Tools → Convert results now have a Download button, like Clone and Design takes (fixes #3414) (#3426)
- Updated the Android Home navigation test for the compact hero title. (#3410)
